rows.desc: setup: a valid waiver closes the waived S1 finding (status closed, waiver id recorded, no revision)
root finding: while the waiver is valid the closure is current at any revision and reopen_finding refuses (WAIVER_GOVERNS)
after the waiver expires the closure is not current, and reopen_finding reopens it (status open, waiver id cleared)
waiver record now rejected: closure not current and reopen allowed
waiver record now expired: closure not current and reopen allowed
a different waiver record (another id) neither keeps the closure current nor reopens it by itself
no waiver record supplied: not reported current and not reopened (API has no waiver parameter)
non-waiver closure: current at its revision, STALE_CLOSURE at another, reopen works
closed without revision or waiver: UNBOUND_CLOSURE
control: closing with a waiver for another finding is refused
ASSURANCE.md says how closure_is_current and reopen_finding treat an expired waiver
